description: A shell script for generating and managing TLS certificates and keystores for Thingsboard, including creating root, intermediate, client, and no-trust certificates, and importing them into keystores.

methods.name: intermediate_common_name
methods.description: Generates the common name for intermediate CA certificates based on current index.

methods.name: set_list_sert_for_cat
methods.description: Concatenates a certificate file path with the current list of certificates for the chain.

methods.name: client_common_name
methods.description: Generates the common name for client certificates based on current client number.

methods.name: client_alias_name
methods.description: Generates the alias name for client certificates based on current client number.
